findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "servicemonster_create_note" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a note immediately (POST /v1/notes); no preview or separate confirmation is enforced. Requires an API User permitted to create notes; Read Only cannot wr…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
